tool_schemas.name: get_root_collections
tool_schemas.description: Lists the account’s root-level collections (no parent) and returns a page of collection records sorted by the requested field/direction; results are cursor-paginated using limit and cursor, and include a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is missing/invalid, limit is out of range, or sort/order is not one of the supported values. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not allowed to read collections for the account, NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: Account ID whose root collections should be listed.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include collections with status=deleted.

limit.description: Maximum number of collections to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_child_collections
tool_schemas.description: Lists direct child collections under the given parent collection and returns a page of collection records sorted by the requested field/direction; results are cursor-paginated using limit and cursor, and include a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id/parent_id is missing/invalid, limit is out of range, or sort/order is not one of the supported values. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not allowed to read the parent collection, NOT_FOUND if the parent collection does not exist (or is not accessible), and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: Account ID whose child collections should be listed.

parent_id.description: Parent collection ID to list children for.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include collections with status=deleted.

limit.description: Maximum number of collections to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_collection_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single collection by ID and returns the collection record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if collection_id is missing/invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the collection, NOT_FOUND if the collection does not exist (or is not accessible), and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

collection_id.description: ID of the collection to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: create_collection
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new collection under the given account (optionally under parent_id) and returns the created collection record with its assigned ID and stored settings (title, view, is_public). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is missing/invalid, title is empty, view is not supported, or parent_id is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you can’t create collections for the account or under the specified parent, NOT_FOUND if the account or parent collection does not exist (or is not accessible), CONFLICT if the parent cannot accept children (e.g., invalid hierarchy), and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: Account ID that will own the new collection.

public.description: Whether the collection is public (maps to is_public).

parent_id.description: ID of the parent collection (omit for root collection).

tool_schemas.name: update_collection
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an existing collection (title, view, is_public, parent_id, expanded) and returns the updated collection record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if collection_id is missing/invalid, any provided field value is invalid (e.g., empty title or unsupported view), or parent_id is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have edit access, NOT_FOUND if the collection (or the new parent, when provided) does not exist (or is not accessible), CONFLICT if the move would create an invalid hierarchy (e.g., parenting into itself/descendant), and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

collection_id.description: ID of the collection to update.

public.description: Whether the collection is public (maps to is_public).

parent_id.description: ID of the parent collection (omit to make it a root collection).

expanded.description: Whether the collection is expanded in the sidebar.

tool_schemas.name: delete_collection
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes the collection and moves its raindrops to Trash, returning the deleted collection’s final state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if collection_id is missing/invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have permission to delete it, NOT_FOUND if the collection does not exist (or is not accessible), CONFLICT if the collection cannot be deleted in its current state, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

collection_id.description: ID of the collection to delete (soft-delete collection; raindrops go to Trash).

tool_schemas.name: empty_trash
tool_schemas.description: Permanently purges all raindrops currently in the account’s Trash and returns a completion result for the purge operation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is missing/invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you can’t purge trash for the account, NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: Account ID whose trash should be permanently purged.

tool_schemas.name: get_raindrop
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single raindrop (bookmark) by ID and returns the raindrop record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if raindrop_id is missing/invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the raindrop’s collection, NOT_FOUND if the raindrop does not exist (or is not accessible), and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

raindrop_id.description: ID of the raindrop to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: get_raindrops
tool_schemas.description: Lists raindrops within the requested scope (collection_id: a collection, 0=all, -1=unsorted, -99=trash) and returns a paged list using page (0-based) and perpage, optionally filtered by search and sorted by sort; when nested=true, includes items from child collections in the selected collection scope. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if collection_id is missing/invalid, page is negative, perpage is out of range, or sort is not one of the supported values. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the requested scope, NOT_FOUND if a referenced collection scope does not exist (or is not accessible), and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

collection_id.description: Collection to fetch raindrops from; use 0 for all raindrops, -1 for unsorted, -99 for trash.

search.description: Optional full-text search query applied to raindrops in the selected collection scope.

nested.description: Whether to include nested/child collections when listing raindrops from a collection.

tool_schemas.name: get_tags
tool_schemas.description: Returns tag aggregates either for a specific collection (when collection_id is provided) or across all accessible collections when omitted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if collection_id is present but invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the requested collection (or to list tags globally), NOT_FOUND if the specified collection does not exist (or is not accessible), and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

collection_id.description: Optional collection ID to fetch tags from; when omitted, returns tags across all collections.

tool_schemas.name: update_raindrop
tool_schemas.description: Updates fields on a single raindrop (title, excerpt, link, important, tags, cover, type, order) and can move it to another collection; returns the updated raindrop. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if raindrop_id/collection_id do not match the required format, type is not one of the allowed values, or any provided field value is invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the raindrop_id does not exist or the destination collection_id does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the raindrop or the target collection, and CONFLICT if the update requests a state change the backend refuses (for example moving into an incompatible/unsupported scope).

raindrop_id.description: ID of the raindrop to update.

important.description: Set true to mark as favorite, false to unmark.

tags.description: List of tag names to assign to the raindrop (replaces existing tags).

collection_id.description: ID of the collection to move the raindrop to.

order.description: Manual sort order within the collection (ascending).

tool_schemas.name: update_many_raindrops
tool_schemas.description: Bulk-updates raindrops within a collection: optionally targets specific ids, otherwise applies to all raindrops in the collection; can set/unset important, replace tags (empty list clears tags), set a cover (including '<screenshot>'), and/or move them to target_collection_id, returning a bulk update result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if collection_id/ids/target_collection_id formats are invalid, any id list contains invalid IDs, or supplied fields are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the source collection_id doesn’t exist, any specified raindrop id doesn’t exist, or the target_collection_id doesn’t exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the source collection, any targeted raindrop, or the destination collection, and CONFLICT if the requested bulk move/update cannot be applied due to backend state/transition rules.

collection_id.description: ID of the collection containing raindrops to update.

ids.description: Optional list of specific raindrop IDs to update; if omitted, applies to all raindrops in the collection scope.

important.description: Set true to mark as favorite, false to unmark.

tags.description: List of tag names to assign in bulk (empty list removes all tags from targeted raindrops).

cover.description: URL for cover image; use '<screenshot>' to set screenshots for all targeted raindrops.

target_collection_id.description: ID of the destination collection to move the targeted raindrops to.

tool_schemas.name: create_raindrop
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new raindrop (bookmark) in the specified collection (or unsorted when collection_id is null) and returns the created raindrop record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (e.g., link malformed, title empty when provided, type unsupported, order < 0) or if collection_id references a non-existent or non-active collection. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if you can’t create raindrops for the authenticated account and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

collection_id.description: Target collection ID for the raindrop. Use null to create in Unsorted.

title.description: Title of the bookmark (if omitted, server may derive it from the link).

important.description: Whether this raindrop is marked as important.

cover_url.description: Cover image URL to store for the raindrop (null clears it).

order.description: Non-negative sort order within the collection.

tags.description: Initial set of tags to attach (deduplicated server-side by normalized name).

tool_schemas.name: delete_raindrop
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a raindrop from active to trashed (soft delete) and returns the updated raindrop record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if raindrop_id is missing/invalid. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the raindrop does not exist, is not owned by the authenticated account, or is already deleted; returns NOT_FOUND for status=deleted. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if you lack access and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

raindrop_id.description: ID of the raindrop to move to Trash.

tool_schemas.name: restore_raindrop
tool_schemas.description: Restores a trashed raindrop by transitioning its status from trashed to active and returns the updated raindrop record. If collection_id is provided, the raindrop is restored into that collection; if omitted, it is restored to Unsorted (collection_id=null). Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if raindrop_id is missing/invalid or collection_id is malformed. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the raindrop does not exist, is not owned by the authenticated account, or is not currently trashed. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if you lack access and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

raindrop_id.description: ID of the trashed raindrop to restore.

collection_id.description: Collection to restore into (must be active and owned by the account). Use null to restore to Unsorted.
